superior_vena_cava.name: Superior Vena Cava
superior_vena_cava.description: Carries deoxygenated blood from upper body (head, neck, arms) to right atrium.

inferior_vena_cava.name: Inferior Vena Cava
inferior_vena_cava.description: Transports deoxygenated blood from lower body, trunk and legs to right atrium.

right_atrium.name: Right Atrium
right_atrium.description: Receives deoxygenated blood from systemic circulation via venae cavae.

tricuspid_valve.name: Tricuspid Valve
tricuspid_valve.description: Three-cusped valve preventing regurgitation of blood from right ventricle into right atrium during ventricular systole.

right_ventricle.name: Right Ventricle
right_ventricle.description: Pumps deoxygenated blood under moderate pressure into pulmonary artery to lungs.

pulmonary_artery.name: Pulmonary Artery
pulmonary_artery.description: Only artery carrying deoxygenated blood; branches to left and right lungs.

pulmonary_veins.name: Pulmonary Veins
pulmonary_veins.description: Transport oxygen-rich blood from alveolar capillary beds of lungs to left atrium.

left_atrium.name: Left Atrium
left_atrium.description: Receives oxygenated blood from pulmonary veins.

bicuspid_valve.name: Bicuspid (Mitral) Valve
bicuspid_valve.description: Two-cusped valve preventing retrograde flow from left ventricle into left atrium.

left_ventricle.name: Left Ventricle
left_ventricle.description: Thick-walled muscular chamber pumping oxygenated blood under high hydrostatic pressure through aorta to systemic circulation.

aorta.name: Aorta
aorta.description: Largest systemic artery carrying oxygenated blood under high systolic pressure to systemic tissues.

interventricular_septum.name: Interventricular Septum
interventricular_septum.description: Thick muscular partition separating right and left ventricles, preventing mixing of deoxygenated and oxygenated blood.

semilunar_valves.name: Semi-lunar Valves
semilunar_valves.description: Pocket valves in base of aorta and pulmonary artery that snap shut during diastole (causing dubb sound).

tendinous_cords.name: Tendinous Cords (Chordae Tendineae)
tendinous_cords.description: Inelastic collagen cords tethering AV valve cusps to papillary muscles, preventing valve eversion.

sa_node.name: Sinoatrial Node (Pacemaker)
sa_node.description: Specialised myogenic neuromuscular tissue in upper wall of right atrium that initiates rhythmic electrical impulses controlling heart rate.

av_node.name: Atrioventricular Node
av_node.description: Nerve node at junction of atria and ventricles that delays impulse slightly to allow complete atrial emptying before ventricular contraction.

atrial_systole.name: Atrial Systole
atrial_systole.narrative: Both atria contract simultaneously. Blood is forced through open tricuspid and bicuspid valves into relaxed ventricles.

ventricular_systole.name: Ventricular Systole
ventricular_systole.narrative: Both ventricles contract forcefully for 0,3 seconds. Atrioventricular valves snap shut (lubb sound). Semi-lunar valves open, pumping blood into aorta and pulmonary artery.

general_diastole.name: General Diastole
general_diastole.narrative: The entire myocardium relaxes for 0,4 seconds. Semi-lunar valves snap shut (dubb sound) preventing backflow. Blood flows passively into atria from venae cavae and pulmonary veins.
